title: pseudognaphalium remyanum
intro: Pseudognaphalium remyanum, commonly known as Lomatium, is a flowering plant native to the western United States and Canada. Lomatium is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Lomatium include its ability to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lomatium are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and glycosides, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
